scene nightsky
I decide to be a man of my word and tap on Kirin’s name in my phone since apparently the two of us go on dates now.

I figure there’s a decent chance she’s either not going to answer or just bail on me once she does as organizing something like this is a lot different than just bumping into each other and running with it.
I get that she likes me — that’s not a new development. And it was obvious she’d have to come to terms with that sooner or later, but that doesn’t mean any of this feels “normal.”
What if it’s becoming too real for her?
If she’s as much like me as she thinks she is, she might already be in the process of backing down.
It’s taken me several iterations of the same exact school year to even begin to accept the idea of change that isn’t directly tied to coital probability and...I just don’t know if she’s there yet.
She might think she wants to run away, and she might think that I’m enough for her, but I know that’s just flat out untrue.
But how do I know it’s untrue, you ask?
That’s easy.
It’s because I’m not enough for anyone.
How can I be when there are still so many parts of me that are missing?
The phone stops ringing.
I had a feeling it would.
scene black
The night ends without me ever hearing from Kirin.
And the two of us move backward instead of forward.
Right back to where we belong.
But then my phone begins to ring.
scene nightsky
And the night begins again.
: Hey! Sorry! I left my phone in the other room while I was doing my makeup. Are we still doing this?
: You mean acknowledging the probability of a relationship between the two of us that exists without any immediate promise or expectation of sex?
: Just say dating, it’s shorter. But yeah. Basically that.
: Then I guess so. That is why I’m calling, after all.
: I think I’m actually getting pretty good at this dating thing. You’re like the third or fourth girl in recent memory I’ve gone on an actual date with.
: Wow, you know exactly what to say to get a woman excited, don’t you?
: You’re not a woman, you’re a girl.
: Doesn’t that make you, like, five times creepier in this context? I’m trying to give you a hand here.
: Also, we’ll see if you’re still calling me a girl after you get a look at me tonight. I am fucking hot right now.
: Great, that means you’ll attract all of the attention and people will stare at you instead of focusing on the age gap between us.
: I’m telling you that won’t be a thing tonight. Trust me. The last thing I want is somebody interrupting our date by asking if you’re my dad.
: Inside the bedroom, that kind of thing is okay. Out at dinner? Not so much.
: Is that what we’re doing? Dinner?
: Do you seriously not even know?
: ...Just kidding?
: We could always go dancing instead! I have plenty of experience grinding on you already, so we won’t even look out of place.
: Dinner it is. I’ll send you an address.
: Okay, but pick a nice place. I want people to see me.
: How nice?
: If there are prices listed on the menu, it’s probably too cheap.
: But I only know one place like that and-
: Cool! Then you know where to go!
: Kirin-
: See you soon, Sensei!
scene black
Kirin hangs up the phone before I have the chance to tell her that the only place I know of that fits that criteria is the restaurant Touka took me to during the first Dorm Wars.
This is even more problematic because, if my memory serves me well, I couldn’t even pronounce anything on that menu.
But I guess it’s fine to be frivolous every now and then considering that saving up my money will do absolutely nothing.
And hey, if it lets Kirin finally experience something she can lord over her sister or anyone else who tries to pick on her, fine.
She doesn’t have many things like that.
And if she’s as attractive tonight as she’s making herself sound-
Actually, if she’s as attractive tonight as she’s making herself sound, I don’t want other people to see her. But I guess it’s too late for that.
After typing “Kumon-mi fancy restaurants” into a search engine, I manage to find the place and...swallow my tongue as I send Kirin the address.
scene kirinfancydate1
We decide to meet around the corner from the restaurant as standing directly in front of a place as high-class as that would have been extremely weird for whichever one of us got there first.
Which, judging by the fact that I am staring at a pair of vending machines instead of a girl, seems to be me.
scene kirinfancydate2
: Excuse me, sir...you wouldn’t happen to be my date, would you?
: No. I have no idea who you are.
scene kirinfancydate3
: Hey. I’m not that unrecognizable.
: You wouldn’t happen to be Kirin’s mom, would you? You look really familiar.
scene kirinfancydate4
: That’s me- here to cheat on my husband and open up the opportunity for you to fuck all of the Kanda women one day.
: You look like five years older than normal, Kirin. It’s weird.
: I clean up pretty good, right? I could probably pass for a college student right now, don’t you think?
: Unfortunately, all I can think of right now is pushing you up against those vending machines and impregnating you.
scene kirinfancydate5
: It’s the skirt, right? It makes me look at least three times more breedable than normal.
scene kirinfancydate6
: Maybe don’t impregnate me, though? I’d be a horrible mom and you’d be no better of a father.
: Yeah, I’d normally agree, but that skirt is doing things to me.
scene kirinfancydate7
: I’ll keep that in mind for the future. Right now, we have reservations.
: I didn’t make reservations. I didn’t think we needed them.
: Yeah, I figured that’s what would happen. Which is why I called and made reservations.
: Oh, cool. That means you’re paying, right?
scene kirinfancydate8
: Not. A. Fucking. Chance.
scene black
Kirin (The suddenly older model) and I round the corner and head into the restaurant.
The first time I came here, the entire venue was rented out for the sake of Touka flaunting her wealth or whatever. But this time, the place is pretty much packed.
The only tables that remain vacant are ones with “Reserved” signs propped up on top of them.
And while this amount of people would normally cause me to worry on account of my date’s age...that doesn’t seem to be a problem tonight.
Sure, Kirin is still significantly smaller than me, but her new look combined with the way she’s carrying herself makes her seem old enough to not be problematic, I guess.
In fact, people probably think I’m rich as hell for bagging someone like her.
scene kirinfancydate9
We’re sat down at a table near the piano, equipped with an accompanying lounge singer, and our orders are taken almost immediately after.
Kirin also manages to order a glass of wine without the waitress thinking anything suspicious- which completely validates my thought just moments ago about this not being that weird.
Well...not looking that weird.
It’s still pretty fucking weird when you think about it. But that’s exactly why I just try not to think about it.
: Good pick, Sensei. How’d you find out about this place?
: I came here on a date with another girl.
: There you go again, always knowing exactly what to say to make me happy.
: This is different than that, though. I don’t think either of us really felt comfortable on that first date.
: Are you saying you feel comfortable with me?
: Kind of, I guess? Which is pretty surprising considering there are other people here this time and the restaurant was empty during my maiden voyage.
: Empty? Did you come with Ayane?
: Touka. Ayane and I don’t really do stuff like this.
: But you and Touka do?
: When there is a prize on the line, I guess so.
scene kirinfancydate10
: Ahh, Dorm Wars then. I’m still jealous I wasn’t picked for that this year. But I guess I did manage to actually win my contest this time, so not all was lost.
: There’s always next year. Assuming the Date War isn’t banned for being too divisive, that is.
scene kirinfancydate11
: To be honest, I’m surprised it wasn’t banned after the first time. Either way though, it’s not like I’d have a real chance at winning against...like, 75%% of the class.
: I refuse to believe I’d lose to, like...Yasu and Yumi. And maybe Nodoka and Molly. But I can see you choosing basically anyone other than those few over me.
: That’s because you have crippling self-esteem issues and dwell on the worst parts of everything ever said to you.
scene kirinfancydate12
: I mean, yeah. But also, there’s not really any “good” part of “You’re not enough for me” that I can latch onto to overcompensate for the bad part. Which was all of it.
: Hey, either I can be honest with you or I can lead you on. Which one do you want?
: Honesty, obviously. I know you might think I’m upset about the whole “not enough” thing, but that’s really not it. I get it.
: In fact, if you told me back then that I was enough, it probably would have been creepy and made me feel weird about seeing you again. So I’m glad that’s not what happened.
: And yet, here we are out on a date because you want to become “enough,” right?
scene kirinfancydate13
: No. We’re out on a date because I wanted to dress up and look hot and there isn’t anyone else who I think would appreciate that as much as you.
scene kirinfancydate14
: But if you just so happen to start liking me more during that date, that’s cool too. I won’t complain.
: And if that just so happens to continue blossoming into something more than just highly-compatible friends with benefits, I also won’t complain.
scene kirinfancydate13
: You’re taking me dancing next time, though. What’s the point in looking all sexy if I don’t get to flaunt it?
: Kirin, do I look like I have ever danced at any point in my life to you?
scene kirinfancydate15
: No. You look like a pathetic, mopey loser. But I look hot and all of my attention will go to you. So, by extension, everyone will think you’re cool as well. We both win.
: And that’s before the grinding happens. When that kicks in, we just win even harder.
: Lowkey, you could probably straight up fuck me in the middle of a dance club and no one would give a shit.
: So it all comes back to sex once again.
scene kirinfancydate13
: It all comes back to-
scene kirinfancydate16
: Wait, no. That’s not the point I wanted you to get from that.

: Yeah, sex is good. And pretty pivotal to the...overall foundation of our relationship, but the whole reason I’m starting to branch out like this is because I want stuff to, like...be more than that. I think.
: Like...I want the option to fuck you in front of a room full of strangers. But I also want the option to just, like...eat with you sometimes.
: And the strangers thing isn’t even like, pure exhibitionist desire either. I only want to do it because it would mean that people, like...see us together.
: That...is what exhibitionism is.
scene kirinfancydate17
: No, like...uhh...
: How do I even put this?
: Oh. You want them to see us together. Like, as an actual couple.
scene kirinfancydate18
: Who just...have sex in public because that’s normal.
: Sensei...no one ever wants me.
: And I want people to think I’m wanted....
: If we say it like that, we can avoid the idea of us being an “actual” couple.
: If you want to be wanted, why are you always saying and doing things that you know will make people dislike you?
scene kirinfancydate19
: I don’t know! I have no idea why I do half of the things I do when barely anything ever comes out the way I want!
scene kirinfancydate20
: Maybe it’s...time for a change of strategy? Maybe it’s good to, like...you know, do stuff that won’t directly hurt people every once in a while?
: You don’t say...
: I’m not pretending I’m an angel when I know full well why no one likes me but you, Noriko, and Miku. And, you know, maybe I don’t need anyone other than you guys.
: I’m just tired of feeling so empty all of the time and sex didn’t work as well as I thought it would in filling me up.
: You seem-
: Don’t do it, Sensei. Don’t make the joke.
: You seem pretty “filled up” every time we have sex.
scene kirinfancydate21
: Hah...pathetic.
: Both of us.
: Here we are in what’s probably the nicest restaurant in all of Kumon-mi, completely incapable of relating to one another without being perverted.

: Well, when a relationship is formed by a girl storming into your office, flashing you her underwear, and trading you her virginity for a handful of excused absences, it’s kind of hard to shake that.
: The chances of that changing at this point basically don’t exist.
scene kirinfancydate9
: What if they don’t have to? What if we can figure out a way to be ourselves and become “enough” for one another?

: That’s exactly what you’ve been missing all along. You don’t have to pretend to be someone you’re not just to get closer to other people. Because, more often than not, that only pushes everyone away.
: Sensei...You do the same exact thing.
: I’m completely real with you, Kirin.
: Yeah, I know. But you’re not real with Noriko and Miku and Karin. The Sensei I see with those people is totally different from the one I always see.
: And, listen...I’m not gonna make this about other girls because this is my chance to be in the spotlight after hiding from it for so long.
: I just want to move forward in whatever fucked up way the two of us can because watching you progress with all of them makes me realize that we haven’t gone anywhere yet.
: We weren’t supposed to.
: This was never meant to be anything more than a way for the two of us to benefit without any sort of emotional attachment. That’s what we wanted.
scene kirinfancydate22
: The convenience store was out of salmon onigiri this morning.
: ...What?
: And the vending machine near the gym? Out of CC Lemon.
: Kirin, what the fuck are you talking about?
scene kirinfancydate23
: I wound up buying ume onigiri...and a can of coffee instead.
: And you know what? I enjoyed them. They really hit the spot for lunch today.
: It was a bit of an abnormal flavor combination, but I’ll probably buy them again next time.
: I don’t-
: No one always gets what they want. And that’s not a bad thing.
: Because sometimes, we don’t even really know what we want until something else falls into our hands.
: Maybe we are destined to be fuck buddies. And maybe I’ll just wind up being your perpetual side-chick on account of my amazing blowjob skills and unrivaled sex drive.
: But maybe...that’s not actually what we want at all.
: Maybe we just want someone we can be ourselves with.
: Someone to fuck when we want to fuck.
: Someone to get dressed up with for no real purpose whatsoever.
scene black
: Someone to dance with.
: What are you-
: Hey! Lounge guy! Play something slower! I want to dance with my boyfriend!
: She doesn’t mean that. You guys are doing great. Keep playing what you’re already playing.
: Don’t listen to him. He has no idea what he wants.
scene kirinfancydate24
: Kirin, what the fuck are you doing?
: I don’t know!
scene kirinfancydate25
: And that’s exactly why it’s so exciting!
scene kirinfancydate26
: Ahh...to be young.
: What should we do, man? My heart says play them a song, but my mind keeps reminding me of that one guy who was fired by that rich little girl despite doing absolutely nothing wrong.
: If we’re gonna go out, we’re gonna go out with a bang.
: Do you think...we should play that song?
scene black
: As if there was ever any other option...
scene kirinfancydate27
: Ladies and gentlemen...we’re going to slow things down for a moment.
: This next one...
: Is called “Despacito.”
: Not...what I had in mind. But this will have to do.
: It’s like this song is following me or something.
scene kirinfancydate28
: Do you know what to do?
: Absolutely not. I would like to sit back down now.
: One song. That’s all I ask.
: Just hold onto me exactly like you’re doing and just...sway back and forth a little.
: People are looking at us.
scene kirinfancydate29
: I know! Isn’t it amazing?!
: We’re the center of attention. Everyone thinks we’re together.
: That’s great for someone like you who likes being the center of attention, but for me it’s-
scene kirinfancydate30
: Who cares? If it bothers you knowing other people are watching, just look at me instead.
: They served me wine and everything. No one has any idea I’m in high school. Let alone that you’re my teacher.
: While that is...slightly better, it doesn’t fix everything.
: No...but it makes me happy. And so it would be nice if you could bear with it for a few minutes.
scene kirinfancydate31
: And so we stay like that for a few minutes...
: You’re thinking out loud again.
: I thought if I narrated how much time went by, you’d believe it.
: It’s been ten seconds, Sensei.
: That’s it? This is even worse than I thought.
scene kirinfancydate32
: Want me to help make it better?
: By poking my face? Why does everyone always do that?
: By kissing you.
: In front of a crowd of people in a fancy restaurant?
: It’s not sex and it’s not a dance club, but I think it’ll have the same sort of mental effect on me.
: Kirin-
: I like you.
scene kirinfancydate33
: I, like...actually like you.
: And I...kind of want...to maybe, like...
: You know...
: Keep doing that...if that’s cool?
scene kirinfancydate34
: Yeah...it’s cool.
: Even though it invalidates the pact I made with Noriko?
: I think you’re probably the only one who still believed in that pact anyway.
: Even though my sister also likes you? And Miku?
: Your sister doesn’t know the real me yet and Miku is fine with me being with anyone.
: Even though I talked for so long about how I’d never want anything more? And that I’m only in this for sex? And how love is stupid and fake and boring?
: As much as I appreciate you talking through Despacito, I would also like if you would stop talking now. You’re attracting more-
scene kirinfancydate35
: Mm!
Okay. Well, I guess that’s one way to stop talking.
: Mn...mnch...mm~
: Sensei...
: Kiss me...harder...
Ahh, fuck it. They’re already looking at us.
scene kirinfancydate36
: Mm! Mmf...mlm...mnnh......hmm!
: I like you...mmlm...I like you...mmh! I really...really...mlm...like you!
scene black
: What did I tell you, Lounge Guy?
: You were right, Piano Man.
: There was never another option.
scene bedroom_night
For the second night in a row, I make it back home after parting ways with Kirin.
Tonight is a little different than the last, though.
scene black
Because tonight, I received an extra gift upon lying down in bed.
Yes, my phone may have just beeped.
And yes, you’re probably thinking that, based on context, she sent me a picture of herself without any clothes on.
That’s what any reasonable person would believe, of course.
This is Kirin we’re talking about.
But what I received instead is something entirely different.
And it fills me with both a sense of extreme discomfort...and another feeling I have a hard time putting into words.
I tap on the new message notification-
And all it says is this:
: Goodnight <3
